mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenues and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals labor market weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases > 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% and unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.3% within the same month, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% and UNRATE increases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines > 10% and UNRATE increases > 0.3% within the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressures, which erodes real returns and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% within the same month, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% within the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, which reduces corporate revenues and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines for 3 consecutive quarters.
